title: Map of the city of Chicago
creator: J. R. Mayer
publisher: United States Army Corps of Engineers
coverage: Chicago city and post-fire street/rail/water framework
credit_line: Public-domain scan via Wikimedia Commons; UW-Milwaukee Libraries
notes: Projected from a trigonometrical survey at approximately 1:20,000; primary annual control for 1872. Local file is a reduced derivative of the 7,665-by-9,083-pixel Commons original.

title: 1873 Map of the City of Chicago
creator: Warner & Beers
coverage: Chicago city limits, wards, streets, railroads, parks, boulevards, and water crib
credit_line: Public-domain scan via Wikimedia Commons; HJB Maps source
notes: Strong city-extent and transportation reference; not a systematic building-footprint survey.

title: Mitchell's plan of the city of Chicago, Illinois
creator: S. Augustus Mitchell
credit_line: Public-domain scan via Wikimedia Commons; Geographicus Rare Antique Maps source
notes: Approximately 1:31,680 annual city reference. Use the separate 1874 bird's-eye only as pictorial context for the July fire event.

title: The City of Chicago, showing the burnt district
creator: Currier & Ives; published in Harper's Weekly
coverage: Bird's-eye city view published in connection with the July 14, 1874 fire; perspective view not drawn to scale
credit_line: Library of Congress, Geography and Map Division, shelf G4104.C6A3 1874 .C5; public-domain scan via Wikimedia Commons
notes: Pictorial event reference only, not a fire-footprint geometry source. Do not warp or derive building fate/polygon boundaries from it. Local file is a reduced derivative of the 6,384-by-4,576-pixel Commons original.

credit_line: Public-domain scan via Wikimedia Commons; Geographicus Rare Antique Maps source
